svg.title: Kasir POS: before and after
svg.desc: Before: Discounts and voids happen with no reason recorded. After: Large discounts and voids need a reason and a PIN, and every action lands in an audit trail nobody can edit. Before: Cash differences are shrugged off at close. After: The shift close counts notes by denomination and turns any shortage into a named record to settle. Before: Food cost is a guess. After: Recipes link menu items to ingredients, and cost of goods follows the price actually paid at the last purchase. Before: Orders shouted to the kitchen. After: Orders reach a live kitchen screen with a timer per ticket. Before: Guests wait for a waiter to order. After: Guests order from a table QR code and pay at the cashier. Before: Sales data locked in the app. After: Any MCP agent can read the shop's numbers with owner consent and scoped access.
svg.text: Before and after
What changed for the people who use it.
